notes: Cats: the Régionale bank's Sparkling/Fortified/Sweet (28 of its 61 stems are fortified) and the Village bank's Fortified Wines. Chapters: the Régionale fortified chapter and the Village Fortified Wines chapter. Regions: one article per Court appellation, Port (douro), Madeira, Sherry (jerez), Marsala (sicily), Banyuls (languedoc-roussillon), Muscat de Beaumes-de-Venise (rhone) and Rutherglen; the south-africa country record carries the Klein Karoo fortified Muscats, which have no region article. Grapes: the Court's grapes the Codex prints, Touriga Nacional, Palomino, Grenache (Banyuls) and Muscat Blanc (Beaumes-de-Venise, Rutherglen, Klein Karoo); the Madeira grapes, Moscatel and Pedro Ximénez have no grape record. Techniques: the roster's fortified group and oxidative ageing with rancio. Service tables: decanting (Vintage, Crusted and LBV Port), temperatures (five fortified rows), digestifs (Vintage Port, aged Tawny, Madeira, sweet Sherry), aperitifs (Fino, Manzanilla, Amontillado, Sercial) and glassware (Port and fortified, the 60 to 75 ml pour).
